جَلِىٌّ Clear, unobscured, exposed to view, displayed, laid open, disclosed, or uncovered: apparent, or plainly apparent, overt, conspicuous, manifest, notorious, plain, obvious, or evident: (S, Msb, K, TA:) جَالٍ thus used has not been heard. (Er-Rághib, TA.) It is applied as an epithet to information, or tidings, (Msb, TA,)
and to analogy, or rule. (TA.) ―
-b2- عَيْنٌ جَلِيَّةٌ A seeing eye. (IB, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
